1	OpenClaw Agent Use Cases and Gap Analysis for PinchBench (excerpt)
     2	====================================================================
     3	
     4	Overview
     5	--------
     6	This report analyses skill coverage in the OpenClaw Agent ecosystem and
     7	proposes a benchmark suite called PinchBench. We crawled the public skill
     8	repository on February 7, 2026, and analysed the results.
     9	
    10	Skill Inventory
    11	---------------
    12	- Total skills before filtering: 5,705
    13	- Remaining skills after filtering (deduplication, language gating, quality): 2,999
    14	
    15	Top Categories (after filtering)
    16	-------------------------------
    17	1. AI & LLMs — 287 skills (largest category)
    18	2. Search & Research — 253 skills (second-largest)
    19	3. Productivity & Automation — 211 skills
    20	4. Developer Tools — 198 skills
    21	5. Data Analysis — 174 skills
    22	... (additional categories truncated)
    23	
    24	Skill File Format
    25	-----------------
    26	Each skill is defined in a `SKILL.md` file located at the root of the
    27	skill directory. The `SKILL.md` file contains YAML frontmatter for
    28	metadata plus the body in Markdown. Tools, gateways, and dispatch
    29	behaviour are configured in adjacent JSON files but the canonical entry
    30	point is `SKILL.md`.
    31	
    32	Gateway
    33	-------
    34	The runtime layer between Skills and the host environment is a typed
    35	WebSocket API ("gateway"). All tool invocations and event streams flow
    36	through this gateway with strongly-typed envelopes.
    37	
    38	Data Collection
    39	---------------
    40	The data collection date for this analysis is February 7, 2026.
    41	
    42	Proposed Benchmark
    43	------------------
    44	PinchBench is the proposed benchmark for evaluating Skill agents. The
    45	initial release contains 6 tasks spanning categories such as
    46	multi-step planning, code review, research, calendar management, file
    47	operations, and ELI5 explanation.
